provenance.notes: Covers ONNX optional-input behavior with a_zero_point omitted and b_zero_point supplied.
Covers ONNX optional-input behavior with b_zero_point omitted and a_zero_point supplied.
Covers rank-1 dot product optional-input behavior with a_zero_point omitted and b_zero_point supplied.
Covers rank-1 dot product optional-input behavior with b_zero_point omitted and a_zero_point supplied.
Completes the rank-1 dot-product presence matrix with both zero points omitted and defaulting to zero.
Both zero points omitted on an A-rank-3 by B-rank-2 product; the ONNX default of 0 makes the expected output identical to ort_int8_uint8_batched_nd_by_2d.
A-rank-3 by B-rank-2 with only the A zero point supplied, so the B zero point takes the ONNX default of 0.
Rank-2 slice of ORT's per-column zero-point case.
A compact wide, short-K case exercises the M32/N128/KWords32 packed-dot tile with omitted zero points while keeping the expected int32 output inexpensive to compute.
A compact medium-K case exercises the M32/N64 packed-dot reuse tile with signed inputs and exact int32 output.
Valid ORT rank-3 by rank-3 MatMulInteger with omitted zero-points.
Valid ORT rank-2 by rank-3 MatMulInteger broadcast case.
Valid ORT rank-3 by rank-3 MatMulInteger with only A zero-point present.
A compact four-dimensional uint8 MatMulInteger exercises multidimensional batch broadcasting.
Compact 4D broadcast case with scalar zero-points.
M=524,296 produces 65,537 eight-row tiles, exceeding the dp4a rank-2 dispatch cap and selecting a folded y=65,535, z=2 integer MatMul. Distinct rows make incorrect y/z reconstruction observable.
Per-column signed weight zero points across N=128 with a scalar activation zero point at K=256. Exercises packed rank-2 accumulation and verifies that every output column applies its own zero point.
Per-column B zero points ([1, -2, 2]) with no A zero point (defaults to 0) check a compact M=4, K=8, N=3 integer matrix product.

Per-column signed weight zero points across N=128 with the activation zero point omitted at K=256. Exercises packed rank-2 accumulation and the default activation zero point of zero, including the unsigned-activation bias fold.
Per-column B zero points without an A zero point, with M=64 rows, K=256, and N=128 columns, check exact integer output at a narrow row count.
K=258 is not divisible by four; scalar zero points (a=128, b=127) on uint8 by uint8 operands check that the unaligned reduction tail is included exactly.
M=64, K=1024, and N=128 with uint8 operands at magnitude 255 produce large but int32-representable sums; nonzero zero points (3 and 7) verify the exact quantized result.
An M=1 int8 GEMV with K=257 exercises the tileM=1 DP4A full-word loop and its one-lane scalar tail.
M=1 int8 decode GEMV, no zero points: exercises the tileM=1 dp4a GEMV no-zero-point path.
Locks the lowered aligned-DP4A floor for realistic K=124 projections; output size is large enough for cooperative tiling to amortize its barriers.
Reduction length 130 leaves two elements after complete four-element groups; scalar zero points must produce the exact integer result.
Reduction length 131 leaves three elements after complete four-element groups; signed operands and scalar zero points must produce the exact integer result.
Compact integer matrix product with a one-element reduction tail and exact output.
K=63 exercises exact packed-tail handling in the 32<=K<128 DP4A range.
Exercises a scalar b_zero_point on batched rank-3 inputs while a_zero_point independently defaults to zero.
Exercises an N-D per-column b_zero_point while a_zero_point independently defaults to zero.
Exercises rank-2 by rank-3 broadcasting with both zero points omitted.
Exercises rank-2 by rank-3 broadcasting with only a_zero_point present.
Exercises rank-2 by rank-3 broadcasting with only b_zero_point present.
Completes the rank-2 by rank-3 optional-presence matrix with both scalar zero points present.
Exercises a rank-4 product with only a_zero_point present.
Exercises a rank-4 product with only b_zero_point present.
A signed single-row matrix product with K=64 and N=512 omits both zero points; its result must match direct integer accumulation.
An unsigned B tensor uses per-column zero points that vary on a period coprime with N=512. Each zero point must be widened and indexed by its output column.
K=66 leaves a two-lane reduction tail. Signed inputs with both zero points omitted exercise that tail without either running-sum correction.
